_comment: NOT a default. This is an annotated recipe for enabling the one already-built self-healing path: a bounded production fallback profile (lower reasoning effort + repair-json-only-v1 prompt) for exhausted text invalid_json/missing_payload incidents, selected by DecisionSupervisor's retry_profile action. Copy only the fields you need into your own config/orchestrator-runtime.json; do not point ORCHESTRATOR_RUNTIME_CONFIG at this file directly (JSON does not support comments, so this key is cosmetic and validate_config() will reject it as an unknown field if you try). online_enabled is still false here on purpose: flipping it to true additionally requires a real GPT_API_KEY (not 'synthetic*') and is a decision only the deployment's operator should make. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Gateway / Profiles) and docs/ORCHESTRATOR_STATUS_CURRENT.md before enabling.
